summary_1line: Vibhishana advises returning Sita for the kingdom’s safety, but Indrajit angrily rebukes him, boasting of the rakshasas’ strength and dismissing Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: In Ravana’s court, Vibhishana stands calmly advising the return of Sita while the furious Indrajit rises to denounce him before the assembled rakshasas.
Indrajit, armored and blazing with anger, points accusingly at his uncle Vibhishana as demon warriors crowd the hall behind him.
